text: This report provides a summary of the activities performed in 2017 by Toronto Water's Environmental Monitoring and Protection Unit, which is responsible for administrative compliance and enforcement of the City of Toronto's Sewers and Water Supply By-laws (Municipal Code Chapter 681 – Sewers and Municipal Code Chapter 851-Water Supply, respectively). In 2017, the Environmental Monitoring and Protection Unit performed 4,570 tasks, such as company inspections, dye tests, meetings with businesses, storm sewer outfall inspections under the Sewers By-law and 412 inspections under the Water Supply By-law. The staff performed 3,401 sampling events, which resulted in 28,891 laboratory analyses.
